text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Greetings, I am Fuji Kiseki! And I shall be working with you from now on, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As an entertainer, I someday wish to
perform
glorious miracles for all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
